model: P(SOG_state_t+1 | SOG_state_t, observed wind_t, observed wave_t)
state_cutpoints: Estimated only from training ship; not safety limits
parameter_estimation: Empirical conditional frequencies, no pseudocounts; unseen condition backs off to speed-only
current_excluded: All 110 Costa hourly matched current values were null in the selected historical model product.
release_scope: Aggregated probability/observed-state counts; no timestamps, coordinates, or raw AIS
